description: Tier 1 command support: cancel, status, prune, purge, media listing
author: Onesimus

views.name: vw_running_jobs
views.query: SELECT j.jobid, j.job, j.name AS jobname, j.type, j.level, j.jobstatus, j.starttime, j.jobfiles, j.jobbytes, j.joberrors, c.name AS clientname, j.volsessionid, j.volsessiontime FROM job j LEFT JOIN client c ON j.clientid = c.clientid WHERE j.jobstatus IN ('R', 'C', 'B', 'e', 'D', 'F', 'S', 'm', 'M', 's', 'j', 'c', 'd', 't', 'p', 'i', 'a', 'l', 'L')

views.name: vw_media_list
views.query: SELECT m.mediaid, m.volumename, m.volstatus, m.mediatype, m.volbytes, m.voljobs, m.volfiles, m.maxvolbytes, p.name AS poolname FROM media m LEFT JOIN pool p ON m.poolid = p.poolid ORDER BY m.volumename

functions.name: sp_prune_expired_volumes
functions.description: Prune abgelaufene Volume-Records (VolStatus='Purged' oder Retention abgelaufen)

functions.name: sp_prune_expired_jobs
functions.description: Loesche Job-Records die aelter als die Retention sind
functions.params: p_client_name text DEFAULT NULL, p_days integer DEFAULT 180

functions.name: sp_purge_volume
functions.description: Purge alle Records eines Volumes (JobMedia + setze VolStatus='Purged')

functions.name: fn_director_status
functions.description: Director Status-Zusammenfassung: Anzahl Jobs nach Status
functions.returns: TABLE(total_jobs bigint, running bigint, successful bigint, errors bigint, total_bytes bigint, total_files bigint)
functions.body: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_jobs, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE jobstatus IN ('R','C')) AS running, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE jobstatus = 'T') AS successful, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE jobstatus IN ('E','f')) AS errors, COALESCE(SUM(jobbytes), 0) AS total_bytes, COALESCE(SUM(jobfiles), 0) AS total_files FROM job;
